description: Pre-online check (streaming): from asleep the vehicle only probes, and a bare online answer without vehicle data connects the stream to check whether the online is real before any vehicle data is requested. Branch 'stream inactive, seems to have been a fake online' sets the check idle, and the next bare probe hits the branch 'stream connected but check idle, allow real online', which releases vehicle data — the strict fetch is answered with the bare payload again, so the machine stays asleep. Pin: only the asleep row, one stream connect. The bare online payload is served twice at the end so the barrier serves are two strict fetches.
